summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end test of verified-content rewrite. Backend KB stats correct (chunks>40, faq_entries=23, easter_eggs=7), grounded answers for verified queries (NeuroBridge, engineer kind, hackathon builds) all pass with verified terms (IIIT Kottayam, 9.03, 400+, full-stack, Routine Visualizer, Sensory Regulation, ASD/ADHD). People-also-ask returns 4 grounded items (no poetic). Frontend pages render verified data correctly across Home, /work (all 6 slugs present), /projects/neurobridge, /projects/vantaai, /research (dsa/achievements/certifications panels present), /contact (email row with mailto), /ai-mode (form + starter questions work, fallback-badge correctly hidden when LLM works), /archive. No forbidden poetic phrases ('20-year-old', 'soft, honest software', 'i write code like letters', 'phoebe bridgers', 'midnight thoughts', 'awake at 2am') anywhere. Two real backend issues, two real frontend issues found.

minor.issue: closest_archive returns 'https://github.com/AnitaGeorge404/' instead of expected '/projects/neurobridge'. Sources list does include NeuroBridge title and related_pages logic appears unrelated. Likely the closest_archive lookup is matching/falling back to the global GitHub link instead of the project URL slug.

Spec requires answer to start with 'I could not find enough verified information'. Instead the LLM answers factually: 'No, Anita does not have a PhD. She is currently a B.Tech CSE undergraduate at IIIT Kottayam...' — this is actually a correct grounded denial, not a hallucination, but it does not match the strict guard behavior the spec requires. Either tighten the SYSTEM_PROMPT to defer all 'does anita have X' negative-credential questions to the guard, or update the spec expectation.

ui_bugs.component: Multiple list renderings (likely Home knowledge panel / Work pins / Research panels)
ui_bugs.issue: React duplicate-key warnings — 20+ console errors of the form: "Encountered two children with the same key, '%s' ... 2024 – present" and '2024', '2025'. Year strings are being used as React list keys but are not unique across the dataset. This is a real React anti-pattern and clutters the console; under reconciliation it may cause subtle re-render bugs.
ui_bugs.selector: console error: 'Encountered two children with the same key, %s'

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow detected: / = 15px, /work = 4px, /ai-mode = 4px, /projects/neurobridge = 4px. The 15px overflow on Home is the most user-visible. Likely a fixed-width element (badge row, knowledge panel, hero subtitle, or AI overview pill) or absolute-positioned decorative element exceeding viewport.
Horizontal overflow on Home (7px). Other tested pages (/work, /ai-mode, /projects/neurobridge) are clean (0px).

Status pill displays 'a living thing' instead of the verified status 'hackathon-recognized' from projects.json. The body copy correctly says 'Hackathon-recognized.' but the side panel STATUS field is showing a generic/legacy label. Suspect ProjectDetail.jsx is rendering a hardcoded or stale status instead of project.status.

Lists 'graph theory, slow software, editorial typography, ethical AI, open notebooks' — but 'slow software', 'editorial typography', 'open notebooks' are not present in the verified projects.json themes for VantaAI (themes are: digital dignity, online safety, ethical AI, protective systems). This panel is likely pulling from a legacy/global obsession list instead of project.themes.

action_items: Backend: fix closest_archive to prefer matching project URL slug over global links when sources include a project — for query 'what is neurobridge' it should be '/projects/neurobridge'.
Backend: decide policy on 'does anita have a phd' — either tighten the no-credential guard, or update spec. Current answer is correct but doesn't match required guard prefix.

Frontend: fix duplicate React keys. Year values (2024, 2025, '2024 – present') are being used as keys for lists. Replace with stable unique keys (e.g., project.slug, role.id, or `${item.year}-${item.name}`).

Frontend: fix mobile horizontal overflow on Home at 375 (15px) and 414 (7px). Inspect hero subtitle, AI overview pill, knowledge panel, badge rows for fixed widths / non-wrapping text / overflowing absolute children. Also fix the 4px overflow on /work, /ai-mode, /projects/neurobridge at 375.
Frontend: ProjectDetail STATUS pill should reflect project.status from projects.json (e.g., 'hackathon-recognized' for VantaAI) not the generic 'a living thing' label.
Frontend: 'CONNECTED OBSESSIONS' panel on ProjectDetail should render project.themes (verified per project) instead of a global obsession list.
critical_code_review_comments: knowledge_base closest_archive fallback logic appears to use a global link list (github URL) when no slug match is found — but for queries that clearly map to a single project the project URL should win. Add a sources-first lookup before falling back to profile links.

Frontend React list keys: search the codebase for `key={...year...}` or `key={item.year}` and replace with unique stable identifiers. The same warning appears 20+ times suggesting it's a single recurring pattern across multiple list renders.

ProjectDetail.jsx appears to ignore project.status / project.themes for at least the VantaAI route, rendering a generic 'a living thing' status and a static obsession list. Verify the component reads from portfolio.js project objects correctly.

Hallucination guard scoring threshold is currently being bypassed by the LLM when adjacent verified context (GPA, certifications) is retrievable — the LLM is reasoning over it and producing a confident denial. Consider either: (a) detecting negative-credential intents server-side and forcing the guard prefix, or (b) accepting verified denials as valid (they aren't hallucinations).

success_rate.backend: 71% (5/7 — TestStats 2/2, TestVerifiedQueries 3/5: neurobridge fails on closest_archive, phd fails on guard prefix; engineer_kind, hackathon_builds, people_also_ask grounded all PASS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (7 tests). 2 known failures pending main-agent fix: closest_archive=GitHub instead of /projects/neurobridge for NeuroBridge query, and PhD hallucination guard returning factual denial instead of guard prefix. Frontend forbidden-content sweep is clean — all P0 content correctness is good. Remaining frontend bugs are: (1) React duplicate keys on year fields, (2) mobile horizontal overflow on Home (15px@375, 7px@414) and 4px on /work,/ai-mode,/projects/neurobridge at 375w, (3) ProjectDetail status pill shows 'a living thing' instead of project.status, (4) CONNECTED OBSESSIONS panel shows stale themes. fallback-badge correctly NOT rendered when LLM works. AI Mode starter questions and search integration both work and return verified content. All 6 work-result-{slug} testids present on /work. contact-email testid renders anitageorge1806@gmail.com.
rca of the issue: 1) closest_archive: backend likely falls through to profile.links.github when no per-project URL match is computed, instead of using sources[0].url when sources contain a project chunk. 2) Duplicate React keys: a `.map(... key={year})` pattern exists where multiple items share '2024' or '2024 – present'. 3) Mobile overflow on Home at 375 (15px) — most likely a non-wrapping pill / horizontal badge strip / decorative image with fixed width exceeding viewport; inspect Home hero + knowledge panel + about-spread bottom panel.
